outcome: Clients now have the same CI teeth as the harness: the vendored roadmap-gate.yml blocks any PR that lands work without declaring its completed story or ledgered window, and runs the full project audit on every push to the default branch - but only once the client has opted in by authoring a roadmap with at least one epic (decision 0036); unprepared repos and the harness itself stay green. Two Gate A day-one defects fixed at the root: a client's first roadmap PR no longer crashes on the missing base-ref file, and Git Flow feature/<key> branches infer their ticket.
